home.intro: I’m Brahim, a software engineer in Casablanca. I explore how things work, bring clarity to complex problems, and build with care.
home.location: Based in Morocco · Open to meaningful conversations
home.approachSub: Clarity in the process. Care in the details.
principleBodies: Ask good questions, listen closely, and find the problem that matters.
Choose practical tools and build things people can understand and use.
Be honest about trade-offs, share progress, and value each other’s time.

pages.workIntro: A selection of projects across web development, backend systems, and the foundations underneath.
pages.aboutIntro: I’m Brahim El Houss, a software engineer based in Casablanca, Morocco. My path through physics and software has shaped a patient, analytical approach to solving problems.
pages.aboutBody: I enjoy exploring new ideas, understanding systems, and turning complexity into something useful. My work spans JavaScript, Python, C, APIs, and databases. I believe the best collaborations begin with clear communication and mutual respect.
pages.valuesTitle: What I bring to a collaboration
pages.educationBody:
ALX Software Engineering · Backend specialization
Physics studies · Hassan II University, Casablanca
pages.servicesIntro: For teams and people who want a thoughtful engineering partner. Scope, timing, and expectations are agreed together before work begins.
serviceBodies: Responsive websites and applications built around the people using them.
APIs, relational data, and integrations that connect the pieces reliably.
Investigating problems, improving usability, and making existing software easier to maintain.
pages.journalIntro: Ideas, lessons, and questions from a life spent learning.
pages.emptyJournal: New notes are taking shape. In the meantime, explore the thinking behind my projects.
pages.contactIntro: Tell me a little about your project or opportunity. Clear context makes a good first conversation.
pages.privacyBody: Your theme preference is stored in your browser; administrator authentication uses essential cookies. Contact details are used to respond to your enquiry. Archived enquiries are eligible for automatic deletion after 12 months; active enquiries may be kept longer. Operational logs rotate automatically and abuse-prevention identifiers are removed after 30 days. Supabase stores submitted data. Email notifications use an SMTP provider when delivery is enabled. No advertising trackers are included. To request access or deletion, use the contact page.
